sn34.46:1.3: One meditator is skilled in projecting the mind purified by immersion but not in the territory of immersion. …”
sn34.46:1.4: One meditator is skilled neither in the territory of immersion nor in projecting the mind purified by immersion. …”
sn34.46:1.5: One meditator is skilled both in the territory of immersion and in projecting the mind purified by immersion. …”
sn34.46:1.6: just as, mendicants, from a cow comes milk, from milk comes curds, from curds come butter, from butter comes ghee, and from ghee comes cream of ghee. And the cream of ghee is said to be the best of these;
sn34.46:1.7: In the same way, mendicants, whichever meditator is skilled in the territory of immersion and in projecting the mind purified by immersion—this one, of these four meditators …
